free_tier.stated: No published byte quota. Official docs FAQ: 'We keep one build for each package in one project indefinitely. All other builds (old packages, failed builds) are deleted after 14 days.' Unlimited projects and builds for Fedora Account holders. Storage is therefore effectively 'one build per package per project, forever', multiplied by packages and projects.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: All other builds (old packages, failed builds) are deleted after 14 days.' Unlimited projects and builds for Fedora Account holders

egress.terms: Free. Results are served from copr-be.cloud.fedoraproject.org and the Fedora CDN; there is no billing or bandwidth meter anywhere in COPR.

tooling: `copr-cli` (create/build/upload), `copr` Python API v3 with Swagger at /api_3/docs/, and plain HTTPS dnf repo access. `copr-cli buildscm`, `copr-cli add-package-*`. No rclone backend.
chaining: unlimited COPR projects x unlimited packages per project x (one retained build each, indefinitely). Because retention is per *RPM Name* within a *repository*, the documented route is: 'Create a separate Copr project for each version' - and the pruner explicitly only groups by RPM Name, so distinct Name: values (golang1.24 / golang1.25 / golang1.26 are named as the alternative route) each keep their own build forever. That is an unlimited-cardinality, indefinite-retention store, and each further Fedora account carries the same allowance again.
limits_note: retention: 14 days for all but the newest build of each package (Pulp backend exception: count-based - keeps the 5 most recent successful builds per package, and 'the 14-day preservation period is not guaranteed'). per-object-cap: src.rpm upload is the write path; no published byte limit found. request-rate: not documented. Build timeout default 5 h, max 50 h. Projects that opted into manual repository creation are exempt from the old package removal.

identity_cost.detail: no identity_cost field and no identity statement in the source record; defaulted to email and flagged, not evidence

reliability_note: Build service that automatically prunes builds older than 14 days, retaining only the newest build or up to 5 on Pulp backends. Submissions must be packaged as source RPMs with valid spec files.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.
